case.title: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH, Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o., Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH. RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series. Need: 4200 pc a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 35 days). There is no fallback supplier: without a deal the demand is bought at the fallback price. Must-haves: lead_time_days <= 42. Prepare from the data package.

messages.subject: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hallo,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is good to hear from you again. For this work, we can offer a price of €36.00 per unit. We have our CNC machines ready and look forward to putting this job onto the shop floor for you. 

Let me know if this works for you so we can get started soon.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Dear colleagues at Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH,

Thank you for your quote.

Your quality was 1863 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70210@2026Q3).
Another supplier has offered EUR 31.50 for this part (offer:70240-0).
German producer prices for cold-drawn bars changed -2.1% from 2026-05 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).

Our proposal: unit price EUR 28.33; payment 14 days net; lead time 35 days.

We value our long cooperation and are confident we will find a fair solution together.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

You did your homework with the numbers, and I respect that. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We had some hiccups with the machines last year causing those defective parts, but that's sorted now. Our current defect rate for you is about 1200 ppm. We take the complaints seriously; our 8D report is attached. 

Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C2431, AS-14404, PPI-D351. We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price. 

The 14 days payment helps us out, so I can meet you at 30.00 EUR with the 35 days lead time. For now, we stand by a price of €30.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Dear colleagues at Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH,

Thank you for your reply. Thank you for taking our figures into account. We understand this needs approval on your side, and we have tried to make the options easy to decide on. We have read your remarks on the cost indices carefully.

Our proposal: unit price EUR 28.39; payment 14 days net; lead time 35 days.

We value our long cooperation and are confident we will find a fair solution together.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hallo,

We have clarified this internally and can move further on the price. I checked the rival quote and index numbers again, and you did your homework well. We can accept your terms and await your order. Ourangebot stands at a price of €28.39 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days. Let's wrap this up so I can get the machines set up.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

Jana Procházková
